description: This file defines numeric types, conversions, and bit array utilities within the Thunder::Core namespace, including template classes for number handling, serialization, and bit manipulation.

classes.name: NumberType
classes.description: Template class for handling numeric types with serialization, conversion, and network byte order functions.

classes.name: Fractional
classes.description: Class representing fractional numbers with integer and remainder parts.

classes.name: BitArrayBaseType
classes.description: Base template class for fixed-size bit array manipulation.

classes.name: BitArrayType
classes.description: Derived class for fixed-size bit array.

classes.name: BitArrayFlexType
classes.description: Derived class for flexible-size bit array.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Static template methods for converting string representations to numeric types.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns string representation of the number.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the number into a string or wide string.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the number from a string or wide string.

methods.name: Abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of the number.

methods.name: Negative
methods.description: Checks if the number is negative.
